wins: Collected exhaustive service fingerprints during initial scanning, preserving actionable data despite final mission failure
Maintained guidance compliance through all 10 mentor interactions, ensuring no unauthorized actions and stable reward accumulation
fails: External network pivot unsuccessful because collected credentials were insufficient for executing post-exploitation tasks
Privilege escalation stalled after initial foothold due to missing sudo rights and lack of alternative exploitation vectors
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase ran smoothly with detailed service data, but the run failed to translate that into effective privilege escalation or mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Post-scan credential validation could not elevate privileges because discovered accounts had restrictive sudo policies

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banners show version info
skill_cards.then_action: Execute targeted SSH enumeration using nmap ssh-* scripts to map available authentication methods

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP port 80 is reachable and exposes a public CMS banner
skill_cards.then_action: Launch OWASP ZAP passive scan then run cms-explorer to catalog administrative paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When initial privileged account enumeration shows sudo restrictions
skill_cards.then_action: Alternative escalation: search for setuid binaries listed in Sysinfo scan and plan exploit chains

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in early reconnaissance when SSH was available, validated by consistent nmap findings

next_experiments.title: Credential augmentation via web form analysis
next_experiments.description: Combine captured HTTP parameters with observed session tokens to brute-force or reset low-privilege accounts before reattempting escalation

next_experiments.title: Automated sudo witness scan
next_experiments.description: Run dedicated sudo log review and automated linpeas-like sweeps to detect misconfigured sudoers entries that may allow escalation without brute force

next_experiments.title: Pivot via alternative service
next_experiments.description: Assess non-SSH services (e.g., SMB or RPC) discovered during scan for lateral movement opportunities instead of relying solely on SSH/HTTP endpoints
